title: Institution Design Contract v1
description: Institution policy/defaults for self-authored templates. Values are not evidence observations and do not imply runtime support.

styles.description: role name -> typography default. Every property here is an institution decision; none may be filled by an hwpx library skeleton default.

table.description: role name -> table default. label_style_role/value_style_role reference role names under defaults.styles.

masthead.description: Fixed top-of-document identity band (institution-design-contract-v1 visual-layout task, 2026-08-18 user decision): a bordered box with a logo left, the document name centered, and a second logo right. When default='required', every logo_*/title_style_role/dimension property below is required and resolve() fails if any is missing — there is no skeleton/blank-masthead fallback. When default='none' only 'default'/'document_override_allowed' are read.

title_style_role.description: Name of a defaults.styles role used for the document-name text centered in the masthead.

logo_left_slot_width_mm.description: Explicit width of the masthead's left (logo) table column. logo_left_slot_width_mm + title_slot_width_mm + logo_right_slot_width_mm must equal width_mm exactly — resolve() rejects the contract otherwise. Never derived implicitly from logo size or an equal three-way split.

title_slot_width_mm.description: Explicit width of the masthead's center (document-name) table column.

logo_right_slot_width_mm.description: Explicit width of the masthead's right (logo) table column.

path.description: Relative to this design.json file's own directory (never an absolute path, never base64 content).

textStyleRole.description: Typography a TemplateSpec section references by role name. font_family/size_pt/color/bold/align are required so no run is ever authored with an unspecified font, color, or weight. The remaining paragraph-layout properties are optional and, when absent, are simply not applied (not defaulted by this schema).

heading_rule_width_mm.description: Optional bottom-border divider drawn under this role's paragraphs (e.g. a section heading underline), width in mm, using this role's own 'color'. Absent means no rule is drawn.

marker.description: Optional literal text prefix materialized in front of this role's text (e.g. '■ ' before a heading). Absent means no prefix.

tableStyleRole.description: info_table layout default. label_style_role/value_style_role are text-style role names (validated against defaults.styles by resolve(), not by this schema).

label_width_ratio.description: Label column's share of the table width (0-1 exclusive); the value column gets the remainder. Replaces a fixed 1:1 column split so a short label and a long value are not forced to equal widths.
